items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: when Bob Mabane had to go into the service, we picked up Jimmy Forest.

ctx.x: But anyway, we got back to New York. Everybody was mad by that time. And they booked us on a tour that carried us all the way out to Texas. When we got to Kansas City, Buddy, Charlie Bird Freddy Culver, Orville Minor, several of them quit, you know. Gus and I -- and there was only a few of us that stuck with Max Hand. McShann

So that's when Bird -- I'd say -- officially left himself. That's when we picked up Jimmy Forest. We came back into New York again. No, we had to send for Jimmy Forest. We had heard Jimmy Forest the summer before; when Bob Mabane had to go into the service, we picked up Jimmy Forest.
Now, when we got out to Dallas again, then we --
